# table-pause: end
execute as @a[scores={sp_settings=1..}] unless score @s ct_paused matches 1 unless entity @s[tag=ct.paused_return] at @s run function splendor:settings/save
execute as @a[scores={sp_action=1..}] unless score @s ct_paused matches 1 unless entity @s[tag=ct.paused_return] at @s run function splendor:ui/handle
execute as @a[tag=sp.player,scores={sp_drop=1..}] unless score @s ct_paused matches 1 unless entity @s[tag=ct.paused_return] at @s run function splendor:input/drop
execute as @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=ct.controller,scores={ct_game=22,ct_state=1}] unless score @s ct_paused matches 1 unless entity @s[tag=ct.paused_return] at @s run function splendor:game/tick
execute as @a[tag=sp.player] unless score @s ct_paused matches 1 unless entity @s[tag=ct.paused_return] unless entity @s[tag=ct.player] run function splendor:player/clear_state

execute as @e[type=minecraft:interaction,tag=sp.hit] if data entity @s interaction at @s run function splendor:direct/click

execute as @a[tag=sp.player,scores={sp_dye=1..}] at @s run function splendor:direct/dye_drop

execute as @e[type=minecraft:item] if items entity @s contents *[minecraft:custom_data~{splendor:{gem:1b}}] run kill @s
visual/bank:
$data modify storage splendor:visual count set from entity @s data.splendor.bank[$(slot)]
$data modify storage splendor:visual model set value "$(model)"
$data modify storage splendor:visual slot set value $(slot)
data modify storage splendor:visual kind set value 4
$data modify storage splendor:visual id set value $(slot)
function splendor:visual/bank_pose with storage splendor:visual
function splendor:visual/spawn
visual/init:
tag @s add sp.visual
scoreboard players operation @s sp_table = #vis_table sp_ctx
scoreboard players operation @s ct_id = #vis_table sp_ctx
$scoreboard players set @s sp_vid $(id)
$scoreboard players set @s sp_vkind $(kind)
$data merge entity @s {item:{id:"minecraft:paper",count:1,components:{"minecraft:item_model":"card:splendor/$(model)"}},item_display:"none",brightness:{block:15,sky:15},shadow_radius:0f,view_range:0.5f}
function splendor:visual/pose with storage splendor:visual pose

execute if score @s sp_vkind matches 2..4 run function splendor:direct/spawn with storage splendor:visual pose
direct/sync_gem:
$execute store result score #inventory_count sp_ctx run clear @s minecraft:$(item)[minecraft:custom_data~{splendor:{gem:1b}}] 0
$execute if score #inventory_count sp_ctx matches $(count) run return 0
$clear @s minecraft:$(item)[minecraft:custom_data~{splendor:{gem:1b}}]
execute if score #gem_count sp_ctx matches 1..64 run function splendor:direct/give_gem with storage splendor:direct
